verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at developer.productboard.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which says that appending .md to any docs page returns a markdown version. Many cited reference pages are served as .md, including agent-specific MCP install and example docs, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or independent community confirmation.
